Introduction & About Aerchain

Aerchain is an AI-native spend operating system — the only Indian platform that carries both a full source-to-pay suite and a best-in-class autonomous-sourcing engine. We do not replace SAP. We sit over the existing S/4HANA, MDG and Ariba estate as the agentic execution and intelligence layer.

Understanding Adani’s Requirement

Adani is one of India’s most mature SAP customers. The estate is largely built; the next move is intelligence, not integration. This proposal maps directly to the two priorities surfaced on 27 May: a faster, governed vendor-onboarding and due-diligence process, and an autonomous sourcing layer for the tactical and tail spend — both sitting on top of Ariba, MDG and SAP.

The estate, as it stands
SAP-heavy, well-consolidated, MDG-governed
  • ERP: SAP S/4HANA — 14 instances today, potentially growing to 18 as more businesses are brought under the group umbrella. ECC still present in pockets.
  • Master data: SAP MDG / OneData, hub-and-spoke across the group. ECC remains the system of record for cost centres and GL under SOX; objects are created once and synced, never duplicated.
  • Procurement: SAP Ariba group-wide since 2021 — Sourcing, SLP, Contracts, Spend Analysis. Sourcing is well adopted; SLP, Contracts and Spend Analysis adoption is mixed.
  • Network: SAP Business Network for vendor transactions.
The spend, where we win
Strategic stays; we take the tactical & tail

Of the $20B+ routed through Ariba, the strategic core is well served. The opportunity is the slice where Ariba’s transactional spine hits its limits — high-volume, lower-value spend with no human bandwidth for competitive bidding, and the ~70% of vendors who sit in the tail.

Strategic · bulk commodities, EPC, capex, fuelsAriba retains
Tactical · MRO, services, logistics, mid-value capexAerchain
Tail · indirect, plant-local, MSME, ad-hocAerchain
The live pain — vendor onboarding & due diligence
Slow & fragmented today

A deliberately stricter onboarding process — built to de-risk bad vendors — has become very lengthy. No single owner; the vendor is spread across SAP, Ariba and MDG. Blocking and blacklisting still run over email.

Costly third-party diligence

The current TBDT process — adverse media, financial, legal and business risk — is commercially expensive and externally dependent, with no configurable per-BU risk appetite.

Unstructured master data

No structured OEM-vs-dealer tagging in MDG (SKF, Schaeffler, NSK and their channel partners), and multiple codes per item — so AI can’t yet make policy-aligned recommendations.

What we sit on top of — and where it goes
Layer on Ariba/MDG/SAP now; transition toward SAP-direct as the estate standardises

Phase 1, Aerchain is the AI onboarding, due-diligence and sourcing front end on top of Ariba, writing back to SAP and MDG. As the estate grows from 14 toward 18 instances and processes standardise over time, the same orchestration layer migrates progressively to SAP-direct where Ariba is retired — without forcing a rip-and-replace at any point. This mirrors the “sit on top, then expand” pattern already in production at conglomerate scale.

Honest scope boundaries. Aerchain is a technology platform, not a catalog aggregator — third-party marketplace (L2 punch-out) integration into your Ariba is already handled natively by Ariba and is not part of this proposal. Contract redlining / track-changes authoring is on our roadmap, not in current scope; we generate contracts from awards and hold the rate-contract repository today. Atlas (the conversational agent) reaches general availability shortly and is positioned as an enablement layer, not a Phase-1 dependency.

Solution Scope

An upstream agentic procurement suite, governed and SAP-native: request capture for every business user, autonomous and strategic sourcing through to award and PO sync, AI vendor onboarding with automated due diligence, vendor performance management, and live spend intelligence.

Proposal Coverage — Two Core Commitments
1
Platform Subscription (SaaS) — the full Source-to-Pay suite (Modules 1–4): Vendor Onboarding & Management, Intake & Orchestration, Sourcing & Negotiation, and P2P & AP Automation. A single group-wide enterprise licence — unlimited users, all 24 BUs, price-locked for 3 years.
2
Implementation & Integration Services — deploy all three modules: configuration, SAP S/4HANA / Ariba / MDG integration, UAT, change management, training, and 90-day hypercare. Milestone-linked — no upfront beyond 20% of contract value.
Module 1 — Vendor Onboarding & Management Module 2 — Intake & Orchestration Module 3 — Sourcing & Negotiation Enterprise Integration (SAP / Ariba / MDG) Infosys — System Integrator Module 4 — P2P & AP Automation
Phase 1 landing scope: Vendor onboarding with AI-assisted due diligence as the wedge + autonomous sourcing for tactical and tail spend + strategic sourcing orchestration over the existing Ariba / SAP / MDG estate. Integration is a dedicated program line — not bundled into platform fees.
Upstream Agentic Suite — In Scope
Intake & Orchestration
Enterprise-wide request capture for 15,000 business users via a single co-pilot — sourcing, contract, onboarding or invoice requests, with AI auto-classification and policy-based routing. Zero procurement training for requesters.
Autonomous & Strategic Sourcing
From a vague intake to a complete RFQ — SOW, payment terms, Q&A, vendor shortlist — auto-built and launched. Configurable autonomy per category: suggest, co-pilot, or full-auto. Human-in-the-loop for the first months, then touchless.
Negotiation, Award & PO Sync
Multi-round autonomous negotiation (discovery → benchmark pressure → target push) with a transparent should-cost model. Natural-language award scenarios. Award/PO written back to Ariba and SAP S/4HANA via API.
Vendor Onboarding + Due Diligence
AI-assisted registration (buyer-initiated or self-service), GST/PAN/MCA validation, and automated diligence — sanctions, adverse media, financial and legal risk — via integration with external sources or Aerchain’s own AI signal aggregation against a configurable, per-BU risk appetite.
Vendor Performance Management
Vendor 360 enriched from GRN data — delivery performance, spend trend, price indices, every PO — plus web/news/compliance intelligence. Scorecards and policy-driven re-evaluation triggers (time, compliance, tier-change), with scheduled recertification.
Spend Insights
Category dashboards with live market indices — steel with contract-lock signals, ocean freight benchmarked with a disruption monitor, lubricants priced off crude / base-oil / SN-150 / SN-500 formulas — plus geopolitical supply-risk analysis.

Multi-tenant, multi-BU by design

One orchestration layer, configured per business unit — airports and defence (highly regulated, distinct flows), power, APSEZ, Wilmar — with RBAC, dimension-based scoping, and separate authentication for shared-service entities such as the GCC. Object creation can be restricted to ECC as the single source of truth, with sync-only into Aerchain.

Audit-grade governance

Hard limits the agent cannot cross, soft limits that surface for human review, and an immutable, tamper-evident ledger appended on every agent decision — input, identity, rationale, output, ERP write-back. Eight production guardrails, toggle-controlled per category and BU, satisfying post-facto audit on day one.

Implementation & Integration

A phased program built for an estate of this scale: a connector framework built once across Ariba, S/4HANA and MDG, then declining-cost instance onboarding wave by wave — landing in a contained set of priority entities first, then scaling group-wide as the estate grows from 14 toward 18 instances.

Group rollout — wave-wise transformation plan
Wave 1 · Months 0–9
Land — priority entities
Vendor onboarding + automated due diligence + autonomous sourcing on 2–3 categories, live across 3–4 priority SAP instances. Platform available group-wide from day one for spend visibility and reporting. Human-in-the-loop sourcing.
Wave 2 · Year 2
Scale — across the estate
Additional instances onboarded; autonomous sourcing widened by category; vendor performance management and spend insights deepened across more of the 24 businesses. Confidence-threshold auto-award introduced.
Wave 3 · Year 3+
Standardise — group-wide
Full coverage across all activated instances (toward 18). Progressive transition to SAP-direct where Ariba is retired. Expansion lanes — downstream P2P/AP, broader strategic-spend coverage, MDM rationalisation — activated as agreed.
Phase 1 timeline · 6–9 months

Integration program — what makes Adani different

A single-instance SAP integration is routine. Adani’s distinction is the connector framework built once across Ariba + S/4HANA + MDG, then replicated per instance at a declining unit cost as the estate is onboarded wave by wave. This is why integration is scoped as its own program line — not buried in subscription — and why per-additional-instance onboarding beyond Wave 1 carries a fixed, predictable rate.

Bi-directional connectors Front-end configurable Webhook write-back No back-end dev Multi-realm / multi-currency

Co-delivery with Adani’s SI partner is fully supported — this proposal scopes Infosys as System Integrator, and other SIs already in the estate are equally supported. Aerchain provides the platform and agent technology; the SI owns advisory, change management and SAP-side integration.

Platform fees are annual SaaS; implementation is one-time (Aerchain, excludes the Infosys SI add-on). Modules 1–3 are unchanged from the upstream proposal. Module 4 (P2P & AP) is the highest-transaction-volume module — PR-to-PO, invoice OCR, 2/3-way match and AP automation across ~100K POs and a larger invoice base, all 24 BUs, with SAP write-back. Years 2–3 = platform only ($2,100,000), price-locked. Billed on activation: Modules 1–3 (Phase 1) bill at the $950,000 run-rate from Phase-1 go-live; Module 4 (P2P & AP) adds $1,150,000 only when it activates in Phase 2, stepping the run-rate to the full $2,100,000. Adani pays only for what is live.

What the $2.1M actually pays for — the full cost stack. The annual platform fee is built bottom-up. Approximately $0.80M / year (~$67K / month, ~$2.68 / cycle) is Aerchain’s internal AI operating (token) cost to run the full autonomous intake-to-pay agent stack across ~300,000 procurement cycles (of which ~100,000 become formal POs).
